figurative_meaning_en: Unreal/impossible/non-existent thing; nothing at all; trick or deception
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি ঘোড়ার ডিম খুঁজছো, এটা কখনো হবে না।
ওর কথা ঘোড়ার ডিমের মতো, একদম ফাঁকি।
example_sentences_in_english: You're looking for a horse's egg; it will never happen.
His words are like a horse's egg, complete trickery.
note: This idiom draws from the biological impossibility of a horse laying an egg, emphasizing absurdity in Bengali oral traditions.
